name: Music Turbo
summary: A full song in eight steps with MiniMax Music 3 and its 8-step turbo LoRA: several times faster than the plain app, made for drafts and batches.

source.notes: The plain Music app's graph with the 8-step turbo LoRA on the DiT, the sampler at 8 steps (euler / simple), and the tiled audio decode wired in. Caption, lyrics, max duration, CFG and top-k stay the text encoder's own inputs.

inputs.label: Style
inputs.default: upbeat cumbia with accordion and modern synths, 100 bpm
inputs.help: Genre, instruments, mood, tempo and production; the model reads it as a caption.

inputs.label: Lyrics (optional)
inputs.help: Section tags in brackets ([Verse], [Chorus]); leave empty for an instrumental.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: The turbo LoRA is trained for 8 steps; fewer are rougher, more barely help.

notes: The same graph and weights as Music, with the 8-step turbo LoRA (minimax_music3_turbo_lora_8step.safetensors, strength 1.0) on the diffusion model and the sampler at 8 steps with euler. It is not in the audio pack, so keep the file in ComfyUI/models/loras. Use Music Turbo HQ (12 steps) when a draft is good enough but the final still needs more. The MP3 lands in riverfield/music-turbo.
